ownership.quote: Release delivers staging environments as a service. With Release a staging environment is automatically generated with every Pull Request which removes the bottleneck most companies have when they only have a single staging environment.

stage.quote: Release, which provides environments-as-a-service (EaaS), has announced it has completed a $20 million Series A funding round.
stage.note: Last priced round is the $20M Series A (announced Oct 2021, led by CRV), following a $2.7M seed that closed April 2020 / was publicly announced April 2021. No later round found as of check date.

total_funding_usd.basis: sum of confirmed rounds per company blog posts: $2.7M seed (Sequoia, closed Apr 2020) + $20M Series A (CRV, Oct 2021)
total_funding_usd.quote: Today we are super excited to announce our $2.7M Seed round led by Sequoia Capital.

last_round.quote: Today we’re announcing a $20M Series A funding round led by CRV with participation from Sequoia, Y Combinator, Bow Capital, Artisanal Ventures, SOMA, Amit Agarwal (CPO of DataDog), Chase Gilbert (Built) and Bill Clerico (WePay).

note: YC hint confirmed: Y Combinator company page for 'Release' (slug release, W20/Winter 2020, status Active, website https://release.com) matches the card's domain (release.com/pricing) exactly — same company. Founded by Tommy McClung, Erik Landerholm, and David Giffin (ex-TrueCar). Product pivoted/expanded from staging-environments-as-a-service (ReleaseHub) toward an AI infrastructure/sandbox orchestration product (Release.ai / AI Sandbox API), per a 2024 Launch HN post, while keeping the original EaaS/dev-environments business. No funding round found after the Oct 2021 Series A as of 2026-09-30; no public revenue/ARR figure found.
